text:
sara_ops: Deploybot is about to start v2 rollout to eu pool-5 at 22:00 UTC but ops noticed a maintenance window scheduled at 22:10 for that pool. Can we hold? :eyes:

deploybot: roll id=rb-1798882222 scheduled to start 2026-06-15T22:00:00Z -> pool-5. rollout plan: 10% -> 25% -> 50% -> 100% over 45m. maintenance window in pool-5 at 2026-06-15T22:10:00Z (duration 20m).

alex_releng: who scheduled the window? I didn't expect any infra work. If the roll overlaps a maintenance that may cause false positives in canaries. Recommend pause until after maintenance or shrink the rollout.

mina_sre: confirmed — storage team booked emergency kernel upgrade in pool-5 (change id CHG-5544). They requested minimal traffic 22:10-22:30. If we run rollout we risk cascading retries and client errors.

sara_ops: suggestion: delay rollout by 40m OR proceed but pin high-volume tenants to v1 for the window. Which is less risky?

todd_pm: we prefer to stay on schedule for customers waiting for v2 features, but not at the cost of causing errors. If delay introduces a big business impact we need to evaluate. How many tenants are high-volume in pool-5?

mina_sre: top volumetric tenants in pool-5: T-4100, T-4101, T-4209. They drive 60% of streaming traffic at that pool. Pinning them to v1 during the maintenance would minimize user-facing impact.

alex_releng: we can also shrink initial rollout to 5% and skip the maintenance hosts (node affinity), but that adds complexity. Pinning is quicker.

sara_ops: ops command to pin: `deploybot pin-tenant T-4100 --api v1 && deploybot pin-tenant T-4101 --api v1 && deploybot pin-tenant T-4209 --api v1`

deploybot: tenants T-4100,T-4101,T-4209 pinned to v1. cfg commit cfg-3f2a9e.

todd_pm: I want customer comms drafted explaining the temporary pin during maintenance. Keep it short: timeframe + no action required.

kate_pm: drafting note: "We will delay your v2 routing during a scheduled maintenance in EU between 22:10-22:30 UTC. You are temporarily pinned to v1 to avoid interruptions. No action required." will push to customers and update release notes.

mina_sre: infra team requests that any rollout traffic be minimized 10 minutes before maintenance start to reduce retries. Can we scale down rollout pace to 0%->5% and hold until 22:35?

alex_releng: agreed. Plan: start rollout at 22:00 with 5% for canary-only nodes excluding maintenance hosts, soak 10m, then hold at 5% until 22:35, then continue normal increment if no regressions. That avoids a full delay and keeps progress.

sara_ops: implementing plan: `deploybot schedule rb-1798882222 --start 2026-06-15T22:00:00Z --initial 5% --hold-until 2026-06-15T22:35:00Z --exclude-hosts hostpool-5-maint`

deploybot: rollout scheduled with initial 5% and hold-until 2026-06-15T22:35:00Z. excluded host group: hostpool-5-maint.

mina_sre: granting infra thumbs: CHG-5544 owners acknowledge reduced traffic window. If anything spikes, they will abort maintenance.

todd_pm: approvals: @alex_releng + @mina_sre + @kate_pm please sign off on pin + hold plan for customer comms.

alex_releng: signed.

kate_pm: signed.

mina_sre: signed.

sara_ops: ops checklist: monitor error_rate(/v2/stream), tail logs for 5xx/422, watch queue depth on edge proxies, ready to unpin if false positives.

docs-bot: PR created for release notes and status update: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/501 ";"
